Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red signal on a commercial corridor in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle directly behind,
operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper at a speed consistent with the damage seen on both cars. Driver 2
stated that the brakes did not respond in time and that the impact was unavoidable. Two independent witnesses on
the adjacent sidewalk gave statements matching this account, and photographs taken at the scene show the rear
damage on Driver 1's vehicle and the front-end damage on Driver 2's vehicle in a pattern consistent with the reported
impact. Drvier 1 and Passenger were both in the vehicle at the time, and officers confirmed their presence at the
scene. Driver 1 reported neck and back pain and was transported for evaluation. No prior damage to Driver 1's
vehicle was noted during the inspection, and officers observed no signs of an earlier collision. Driver 1 is listed as a
member of the policyholder's household.
